items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Most of the core diff is hidden. The tests are clear but very long and copy-pasted across 6 adapters with the same giant name ('should preserve restored query state, refetch error, counters, ...'). Tests reach into the cache with `new (queryCache.constructor as any)`.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: createPersisterRestoreResult lives in query.ts, not a separate persister.ts as the project asked. It also edits #dispatch and QueryObserver.createResult, so restore handling spreads into general fetch/observer code. Near-identical ~140-line tests are duplicated in every adapter.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: There is no visible normalisation of persisted state (counts, timestamps, a persisted 'fetching' status) like the reference's normalize helpers. It relies on fetchStatus being forced to idle. Hidden tests pass (8/8, 42/42). No swallowed errors seen.

items.name: Restore path API contract
items.name_zh: 恢复路径 API 约定
items.evidence: Exported from index.ts and recognised in Query.fetch, which skips onSuccess/onSettled (tested). It is not shown to use a dedicated reducer action or a symbol marker. Whether bulk restore shares one helper is unclear from the visible diff.

items.name: Existing persister contract preserved
items.name_zh: 保持既有 persister 约定
items.evidence: The plain-data path seems intact and the exports are additive. But the #dispatch and QueryObserver.createResult changes keep fetchFailureCount/Reason whenever data !== undefined. That changes optimistic mount results for all queries, not just restored ones.

validity_flags.basis: existing test lines changed/removed (1): packages/svelte-query/tests/createQuery.svelte.test.ts; existing test lines changed/removed (1): packages/vue-query/src/__tests__/useQuery.test.ts
